description: hello with an unrecognized top-level field (e.g. a typo of max_streams). This IS tolerated by the wire at runtime for forward compatibility (OVERVIEW.md section 2.7 'Envelope validation and forward compatibility': unknown field inside a known t is ignored), but control.schema.json is the strict test-time conformance oracle (additionalProperties:false on every leaf) and is deliberately stricter here so it catches field-name typos during development -- see OVERVIEW.md section 6 and the schema's own top-level description.
